name: Romo's Mediterranean Chicken Kabob & Rice Plate (No Lemon/Onion Mod)
whyItWorks: Charbroiled chicken tenderloin kabobs over fluffy basmati rice with warm soft pita bread provide lean, dairy-free protein without heavy sauces.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Souvlaki/Kabob Plate with basmati rice and warm pita bread—ask for no lemon juice squeeze, no raw red onions, and tzatziki/hummus on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the Greek salad (raw tomatoes/onions/olives/feta) and ask for no lemon squeeze on the kabob
